job: See how values change over time or between periods.
purpose: An SVG line, area, bar or stacked bar chart from a JSON config: labels, up to six series, an optional threshold. Hairline grid, mono axes, the first series in the accent. Lines draw in once on scroll. A crosshair and tooltip follow the pointer, a finger or the arrow keys. Every chart has role="img" and a hidden data table. A fifth type, quadrant, places points on two axes and names the four corners; on a phone it becomes a list grouped by corner.
useWhen: A value moves continuously over time: use line, or area for volume.
Discrete periods are compared: use bar, or stacked for a total and its parts.
A number has a limit: draw a labelled threshold on the chart.
A live series should end in a pulsing dot.
A handful of things are sorted on two measures at once, such as cost against reliability: use quadrant.

avoidWhen.when: A direction beside a figure, without axes.
Parts of a whole with two to five segments.
Exact values to compare across many columns.
More than about a dozen points to place, or exact values matter more than position.

states.name: live
